title: fix(ui): the view and page-block filter builders offer a picklist field's options
body:
Fixes #36216

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在工作室里给视图变体、页面（基础筛选与标签页预设）和页面里的关联列表写筛选条件时，选择"下拉选项"类字段后，值现在是一个列出该字段选项的下拉框，不再是随手输入的文本框；文本字段不变。
- 属于"工作室筛选编辑器字段信息不全"这组修复，补上上一次只修了"多选"标记、没带上选项列表的那几处筛选编辑器。
- 影响在工作室或应用内视图设置里写筛选的管理员；只改界面给出的输入控件，已存的筛选原样不动，可以直接撤回。
- 要你做的一件事：无。

## What changes

A `select` field's declared `options` (the spec's `SelectOption`, `{ value, label }`) reach the shared runtime `FilterBuilder` on every host that builds the `filter-builder` field list, so a picklist row's value is a picker over the field's choices and stores the option's `value`. Before, three builders (and the catalog one of them is fed by) dropped `options`, the builder fell back to a free-text box, and a typed label saved a filter that matches no record.

`FilterBuilderField` already forwarded `options` (the list-view inspector's picklist fix); the field lists handed to it did not carry them. Measured at `e343ab7c`, where each list is built:

| Host | Field list built by | Change |
|---|---|---|
| generic metadata editor (a page's `interfaceConfig.filterBy`, tab presets, any `widget: filter-builder` row) | `objectCatalogOf` in `ResourceEditPage.tsx`, from the raw served object | reads `declaredFieldOptions(f)` |
| view-variant inspector | `ViewVariantInspector.tsx` widget context, from `useObjectFields` | forwards `f.options` |
| in-app view configuration panel (feeds the view-variant inspector an override catalog) | `mapObjectFields` in `ViewConfigPanel.tsx`, from the raw `objectDef` | reads `declaredFieldOptions(f)` |
| page block inspector (`record:related_list` filter) | `FilterRulesField` in `PageBlockInspector.tsx`, from `useObjectFields` | forwards `f.options` |

`useObjectFields` already normalised a field's options in `declaredFieldOptions` (only string `value` + string `label` entries; absent when none). That function is now exported and is the one reading the two raw-definition builders use, so every host offers the same choices. No consumer-side tolerance is added: entries that are not the spec shape are dropped exactly as the hook already dropped them.

`mapObjectFields` (`ViewConfigPanel.tsx`) is outside the card's named three: it is the override catalog the view-variant inspector reads in the in-app panel, so without it that host kept the text box after the inspector's own fix. Fixed here under the bounded in-place exemption (same defect, same mechanical projection, no other claim on the file, same gate family); see Acceptance notes.

Read first, by risk:

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/ResourceEditPage.tsx`: `objectCatalogOf`, the `fieldOf` projection now a block body. Check both the record and array branches still read `name` as before. The edit stays inside `objectCatalogOf` (the sibling #36688 line is elsewhere).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/previews/useObjectFields.ts`: `declaredFieldOptions` exported, body unchanged.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx`: `mapObjectFields` gains `options`.

Two-minute check: `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.filterBuilderOptions-36216.test.tsx`. Expect 9 passed.

## Tests

New file named for the card, `widgets.filterBuilderOptions-36216.test.tsx` (`FilterBuilderField` has no shared harness file; its other pins are card-named files). One served `ticket` object with a `select` column (`status`, two options) and a `text` CONTROL (`subject`):

- catalogs: `objectCatalogOf` (record and array forms) and `mapObjectFields` carry the declared choices on `status`, and nothing extra on `subject`;
- the `filter-builder` widget over `objectCatalogOf`'s catalog: Add filter, pick Status, the value is a picker (no `Value` box) listing New Request / Completed, and picking New Request writes `{ field: 'status', operator: 'equals', value: 'new' }`; CONTROL: Subject gets one `Value` box and no picker;
- the view-variant inspector, fed by `mapObjectFields` and by its own `useObjectFields` read: Status is a picker over the choices; CONTROL: Subject is a `Value` box;
- the page block's related-list filter: Status is a picker over the choices; CONTROL: Subject is a `Value` box.

<details><summary>Ablation (one mutation per site, on the committed fix c8a45c6e5)</summary>

Each site's `options` spread was deleted with `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs --delete` (anchor 1 to 0, blob moved), the new file ran under the verify lock, and the tool restored it (blob equals HEAD, `git diff HEAD` empty). The tested modules are imported by relative path from `src`, so no `dist` build sits between the mutation and the run.

- `objectCatalogOf`: Tests 2 failed / 7 passed (its catalog pin, the widget picklist case);
- `mapObjectFields`: 2 failed / 7 passed (its catalog pin, the view-variant case over the panel catalog);
- `ViewVariantInspector`: 2 failed / 7 passed (both view-variant picklist cases);
- `PageBlockInspector`: 1 failed / 8 passed (its picklist case).

Every text CONTROL stayed green under every mutation, as predicted.
</details>

<details><summary>Affected suites</summary>

At `c8a45c6e5`, `pnpm --dir ui exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over the existing suites of every edited component (`metadata-admin/widgets*`, `ResourceEditPage*`, `ViewConfigPanel*`, `PageBlockInspector*`, `ViewVariantInspector*`, `previews/useObjectFields*`, `studio-design/ObjectListViewInspector*`): Test Files 105 passed (105), Tests 552 passed (552). The new file: 9 passed (9). `pnpm --filter @object-ui/app-shell run type-check` (the `src` program and `tsconfig.test.json`), after the `@object-ui/app-shell^...` closure build: exit 0. The full `@object-ui/app-shell` suite is CI's (`Test UI`).
</details>

## Acceptance notes

- **Reach measured in components, not in a running app:** the pins mount the real `FilterBuilder` (only the Radix popover is rendered inline) over each real host; no backend or Console was booted.
- **Bounded in-place fix:** `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ViewConfigPanel.tsx` is outside the claim's declared file surface (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/**`). It is the same defect on the catalog the view-variant inspector reads in the in-app panel; the four exemption conditions hold (same defect class; a mechanical one-line projection shaped like the sibling `multiple` line; overlap-check names no other PR on the file; same gate family). Declared here and in the report for the seat to add to the claim's surface.
- `ObjectFieldOption.options` already existed (the list-view inspector's picklist fix); no type was widened. The `field-ref` / `field-multi` pickers read name, label and type only, so they are unchanged.
- `origin/main` was not merged: overlap-check against `0d727b70` (after #36688 landed) reports a clean merge.
